notes: The hashing algorithm is specified in packages/tools/skills/src/integrity.ts and reimplemented identically in apps/cli/src/skills.rs and scripts/verify-skills-lock.mjs.

v1 of this file recorded computedHash values for ai-seo, programmatic-seo, remotion-best-practices, and seo-geo with no algorithm field. Those hashes are NOT reproducible: re-hashing the exact bundle bytes from d694f17b2 under agiskill-sha256-v1 yields different digests, and no generator for the v1 values exists anywhere in the repo. They were never verified against anything.

Those four bundles were themselves deleted from .agents/skills in 5b14585dd, so their entries were also stale. They are dropped here rather than carried forward as unverifiable claims; git history retains the original values.
skills is empty because no skill under `roots` currently exists in the tree. Verification is not vacuous: adding any skill under a locked root fails CI until it is locked with declared provenance.
